flag.prompt: Extreme close-up of a large 1940s American flag with 48 stars filling the entire frame edge to edge, fabric rippling in strong wind with deep soft folds, the blue star canton occupying the left third, red and white stripes running across the rest. No pole, no sky. $PHOTO

archival.prompt: Authentic 1944 black and white WWII press photograph, grainy, high contrast: American GIs packed in a landing craft heading for Normandy, seen from a low angle at water level. The riveted steel ramp and gunwale of the boat run across the bottom third of the frame. In the centre a soldier in an M1 helmet and field jacket leans on the gunwale looking straight at the camera; around him other soldiers in netted helmets, some looking away. On the right a small 48-star US flag on a short pole. Above them only a plain flat white overcast sky.

spray.prompt: A tall dense vertical wall of grey-white sea spray, wet sand and gravel debris erupting straight upward from a shell impact on a beach, filling the entire frame height from top to bottom and about half its width, sharp gritty flying particles and pebbles, dense opaque core with ragged edges. Pure black background, nothing else in the image.
